title: International Multi-Centre Validation of Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Precise Discrimination between Normal and Abnormal Retinal Development
abstract: arXiv:2610.21719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Arrested retinal development can cause childhood visual impairment, but grading optical coherence tomography scans is difficult to standardise across devices and centres. We developed and evaluated an unsupervised domain adaptation model to classify normal and abnormal retinal development across different OCT systems. This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Network was trained using labelled images from a source device and unlabelled images from a target device. We evaluated six source to target pairings and compared model performance with seven clinician graders. A separate Heidelberg Spectralis dataset was reserved for external evaluation. translated_title: 无监督域自适应在精确区分正常与异常视网膜发育中的国际多中心验证
translated_abstract: 视网膜发育停滞可导致儿童视力障碍，但对光学相干层析成像扫描进行分级在不同设备和中心之间难以标准化。我们开发并评估了一种无监督域自适应模型，用于在不同OCT系统之间分类正常与异常的视网膜发育。这项回顾性多中心研究使用了来自四个国家五个中心以及英国生物样本库的OCT扫描数据，数据涵盖四种OCT设备，包括台式和手持式系统。基于ResNet50的域对抗神经网络使用来自源设备的标记图像和来自目标设备的未标记图像进行训练。我们评估了六种源设备到目标设备的配对，并将模型性能与七名临床医生分级员进行比较。另有一个Heidelberg Spectralis数据集被单独保留用于外部评估。在验证集上，准确率范围为87.75%至96.06%，灵敏度范围为88.68%至98.38%，特异性（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究在国际多中心环境下验证了一种基于ResNet50的无监督域对抗神经网络模型，能够在四种不同OCT设备（包括台式和手持式系统）之间准确区分正常与异常视网膜发育，准确率达87.75%–96.06%，性能可与临床医生分级员相媲美。
en_tdlr: This study internationally validated an unsupervised domain adversarial neural network based on ResNet50 that accurately discriminates normal from abnormal retinal development across four different OCT devices including handheld systems, achieving 87.75%–96.06% accuracy comparable to clinician graders.
